description: Call any Scraping Daddy ("SD") endpoint and return its response unchanged.

body.description: JSON request body, for endpoints that take one.

method.description: GET or POST. Must be a method the endpoint declares.

path.description:
Relative AM-CORE route, e.g. "/v1/tiktok/profile". Must be a known
endpoint under /v1 or /v2; full URLs and host overrides are rejected.

name: api_request
title: Call an approved Scraping Daddy endpoint
